verdicts.evidence: internal/config/config.go defines defaultBackendTimeout = 15*time.Minute and applies it to both Copilot and Claude in Defaults(); internal/cli/backend_timeout_test.go's TestBackendFallbackMatchesTheShippedDefault drives a Timeout-less ReviewRequest through the fake reviewer and asserts the deadline it actually ran under against config.Defaults().Backends.Copilot.Timeout (and asserts Claude's equals Copilot's, so the two cannot drift). `go test -race -count=1 ./internal/config/... ./internal/backend/...` and `go test -race -count=1 -run TestBackendFallback ./internal/cli/` both exit 0.

grep for closeWaveTimeout|reviewTimeoutS|closeTimeoutS|verifyTimeoutS across internal/ (including tests) finds only a comment in decide_test.go, no definitions. internal/deadline/deadline.go defines Close/Verify/GateReview/Session and the Grace constant. The four call sites use it: cmd_close_wave.go calls deadline.Close, cmd_verify.go calls deadline.Verify, cmd_review.go calls deadline.GateReview, decide.go calls deadline.Session/deadline.GateReview/deadline.Close.

internal/deadline/deadline.go implements one saturation domain (addDur/mulDur clamp negatives and saturate at MaxDuration) applied uniformly to Close/Verify/GateReview/Session; Close enforces Floor always, sums verifyTerm (undivided by MaxParallel) and reviewTerm (divided by MaxParallel, so Close is non-increasing in it), matching the stated formulas. Tests TestSessionStrictlyContainsEveryInner, TestCloseBudgetsTheWave, TestSaturatesInsteadOfWrapping, TestMonotonicity all exist and `go test -race -count=1 ./internal/deadline/...` exits 0.

internal/deadline/deadline.go's verifyTerm multiplies VerifyTimeout by VerifyCommands undivided by MaxParallel (serial), and reviewTerm multiplies BackendTimeout by 2 (blind + scoped pass) and by ceil(ReviewTasks/MaxParallel) (concurrent), matching the declared shapes exactly. internal/decide/decide_test.go's TestExecTimeoutsStrictlyContainTheBinaryCaps asserts the emitted exec op's TimeoutS for spec/plan review and close-wave each strictly exceeds the binary's own cap (deadline.GateReview/closeCap). `go test -race -count=1 ./internal/decide/...` exits 0.

internal/decide/questions.go's reviewErrorRetryText/backendDeadlines names backends.<name>.timeout and its current deadline per configured backend with a key, skips entries lacking one, and falls back to the literal backendKeyPlaceholder ('backends.<name>.timeout') when nothing is named. internal/decide/decide_test.go's TestReviewErrorNamesTheBackendTimeouts covers a fully-configured set, a set with a keyless entry skipped, and an empty chain. internal/cli/facts.go's comment near gatherFacts states no health probe is made. `go test -race -count=1 -run 'TestReviewErrorNamesTheBackendTimeouts|TestGatherFactsFillsReviewerBackends' ./internal/decide/... ./internal/cli/...` exits 0.

internal/cli/finish_test.go's TestPushPRLeavesTheBodyInHead drives next to the push_pr op, asserts docs/takt/demo/finish/pr.md is present in `git ls-tree HEAD`, asserts the commit subject is 'takt(demo): pr body', then replays next and asserts HEAD's sha is unchanged. `go test -race -count=1 -run 'TestPushPR|TestPreparePushPR' ./internal/cli/` exits 0.

internal/cli/archive.go's prCleanup: CommitExists error or IsAncestor error both fall back to offering the plain push (never returning an error, so the archived stop never fails); missing tracking ref returns the -u form; ancestor-true returns nil (no cleanup); otherwise returns the plain push. internal/cli/archive_test.go's TestArchivedPROffersThePushUntilItIsDone exercises all four states in sequence (no tracking ref, fully pushed, commits the remote lacks, and a diverged branch) including running the printed command; internal/cli/archive_internal_test.go's TestArchivedPRPushIsOfferedWhenGitCannotAnswer and TestArchivedPRPushIsOfferedWhenTheAncestryReadFails inject failures on each of the two git reads and assert no error and the push is still offered. `go test -race -count=1 -run 'TestArchived|TestBranchFinish' ./internal/cli/` exits 0.
